title: Grateful Dead Live at Roosevelt Stadium on 1976-08-04
lineage: sbd reel master>reel>10.5" reel @ 7.5 ips, dolby b technics rs-1506>teac an-180>hd-p2 24/96>cd wave>adobe>flac transferred & seeded by Rob Berger 6/22/09 and Audience (shnid=12078) Source 1: MAC > D > CD *Recorded by Scott Jones, Shure micsSony TC-158 Source 2: unknown aud supplies end of Sugar Magnolia and Encore Transfer: CDR > EAC (secure) > Cool Edit (minor fixup) > mkwact(seekable) Patch Source (shnid=35171) SBD>Cm>Reel>Lucid AD2496>CD>EAC>SHN (Tape Flips Patched w/(FOB) Shure Mics>Cm>Dat>CD) (parts of set 1 patched from video soundtrack) from Charlie Miller via Patrick Clifford Matrix by dusborne using Sound Forge Pro 10.0 and Audacity 2.0 06-11-2012

ai_review.summary: Excellent matrix recording captures a classic August 1976 show with standout Scarlet Begonias and an epic Help‑Slip‑Frank sequence.
ai_review.review: All four reviewers hail this release as the definitive version of the 4‑August‑1976 concert, praising the long, flowing renditions of Scarlet Begonias and the monumental Help > Slip > Frank. The matrix source delivers a lively crowd presence that fuels the band, while the overall sound remains clear enough to make it a must‑listen despite not matching a pure SBD in fidelity.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently 5‑star reviews emphasize both an exceptional performance and a high‑quality recording; the show is described as definitive with standout jams, and the matrix mix is praised for its energy.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear enough to hear every instrument; crowd ambience adds excitement. Noted that a pure soundboard (SBD) version sounds slightly cleaner, but the matrix mix is still highly enjoyable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert flows superbly, with a long Scarlet Begonias segueing into an almost 30‑minute Help > Slip > Frank that showcases the band's improvisational peak.

band_member_comments.Phil: Bass is gut‑shaking and a bit overwhelming, but fans of Phil Lesh consider it a treasure and a highlight of the performance.
